Name: Boarding House to Npc adventures
Author: Mortimer's
TagLine: Bring Sheila and Gregory from Boarding House to an Companion! A Content Pack that brings Trent npc to Npc adventure.
Description:
This is a Content pack for [Npc adventures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582)﻿﻿ that make Sheila and Gregory a full companion!

***This is Sheila!***
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/729077872161193984/Sheila_portrait.png)﻿
**Sheila is a happy girl that will help you in your advenure! She is a good forager and she is very lucky and energy! (She gives you +3 lucky and +2 speed)**

_﻿
***This is Gregory!***
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/729078443316084836/Gregory_portrait.png)﻿__
***Gregory is an great warrior with the experience of the mines! He is an excelent fighter and has some real endurance! (He gives you +5 defense +3 attack)***

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/729080741220188190/Sem_titulo.png)﻿

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)﻿

2.  Download the latest version of [Npc adventures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582)﻿

3.  Download the latest version of [Boarding House](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120)

4.  Download this NA Content Pack﻿

5.  Drop everything on your mods folder

6.  Launch the game via SMAPI

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/729081032850145341/Sem_titulo.png)﻿
